name: decompose a signal into coefficients over a fixed basis
mechanism: express a block of samples as coefficients over a fixed orthogonal basis (cosines, wavelets) using a factorised fast algorithm, so energy concentrates in few coefficients that can be quantised coarsely

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Fast Cosine Transform algorithms (FCT algorithms)' in section Information theory and signal processing / Coding theory / Lossy compression algorithms: computes Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) efficiently
